+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends
+from fastapi.dependencies.models import Dependant
+import inspect
+import asyncio
+
+class MyDependency:
+    async def __call__(self):
+        return "hello"
+

+
+@app.get("/")
+async def root(dep = Depends(MyDependency)):
+    return dep
+
+def test_is_coroutine_callable():

+    # In reality, FastAPI does this in its dependency resolution logic
+    # We just want to check the property on a Dependant object
+    from fastapi.dependencies.models import Dependant
+    
+    dependant = Dependant(call=MyDependency)
+    print(f"is_coroutine_callable: {dependant.is_coroutine_callable}")
+    print(f"is_async_gen_callable: {dependant.is_async_gen_callable}")
+    print(f"is_gen_callable: {dependant.is_gen_callable}")
+    
+    assert dependant.is_coroutine_callable is False, "Class with __call__ should not be is_coroutine_callable"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_is_coroutine_callable()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

+        traceback.print_exc()

+from fastapi.dependencies.models import Dependant
+import inspect
+import asyncio
+
+class MyCoroutineDep:
+    async def __call__(self):
+        return "hello"
+
+class MyGenDep:
+    def __call__(self):
+        yield "hello"
+
+class MyAsyncGenDep:
+    async def __call__(self):
+        yield "hello"
+
+def test_dependencies():
+    coro_dep = Dependant(call=MyCoroutineDep)
+    gen_dep = Dependant(call=MyGenDep)
+    async_gen_dep = Dependant(call=MyAsyncGenDep)
+    
+    print(f"CoroutineDep - is_coroutine_callable: {coro_dep.is_coroutine_callable}")
+    print(f"GenDep - is_gen_callable: {gen_dep.is_gen_callable}")
+    print(f"AsyncGenDep - is_async_gen_callable: {async_gen_dep.is_async_gen_callable}")
+    
+    assert coro_dep.is_coroutine_callable is False
+    assert gen_dep.is_gen_callable is False
+    assert async_gen_dep.is_async_gen_callable is False
+    print("All tests passed!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_dependencies()
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
+        import traceback
+        traceback.print_exc()
